title: 3D Rhythm Game with Save/Load State
prompt:
Create a fully interactive 3D rhythm game using Three.js with save/load state functionality. Generate a single HTML file with all code inline.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 10) looking down a track toward negative Z.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Create a 3D track: a long rectangular plane (width 4, length 60) along the Z-axis, subdivided into 4 lanes (each lane 1 unit wide, centered at x = -1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5).
- The track should have a dark grey material with subtle lane divider lines (thin white boxes or lines at x = -2, -1, 0, 1, 2).
- Load 'Duck.glb' using GLTFLoader from a CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). Scale the duck to 0.4 and place it at the bottom of the track at lane index 1 (x = -0.5, y = 0, z = 8) facing negative Z. This duck is the player's avatar/receptor.

## Note System
- Define a song chart as an array of note objects: [{time: 1.0, lane: 0}, {time: 1.5, lane: 2}, {time: 2.0, lane: 1}, {time: 2.5, lane: 3}, {time: 3.0, lane: 0}, {time: 3.5, lane: 1}, {time: 4.0, lane: 2}, {time: 4.5, lane: 3}, {time: 5.0, lane: 0}, {time: 5.5, lane: 2}, {time: 6.0, lane: 1}, {time: 6.5, lane: 3}, {time: 7.0, lane: 0}, {time: 7.5, lane: 1}, {time: 8.0, lane: 2}, {time: 8.5, lane: 3}]. Total 16 notes.
- Notes are colored spheres (radius 0.3) that spawn far down the track (z = -50) and move toward the player at speed 10 units/second.
- The hit zone is at z = 8 (where the duck is). Notes reaching z > 12 are considered missed.
- Each lane has a receptor indicator: a semi-transparent ring at z = 8 in each lane.

## Controls
- Keys D, F, J, K correspond to lanes 0, 1, 2, 3 respectively.
- When a key is pressed, check if any note in that lane is within 1.0 units of z = 8. Scoring: |dz| < 0.3 = 'Perfect' (100 pts), |dz| < 0.6 = 'Great' (75 pts), |dz| < 1.0 = 'Good' (50 pts). Otherwise it's a miss (0 pts, breaks combo).
- Arrow Left/Right keys move the duck between lanes (update its x position). The duck's current lane affects a visual glow but does NOT affect hit detection (hits are key-based).
- Pressing Space starts/pauses the game. The game begins paused.

## Combo & Scoring
- Track combo (consecutive hits without miss). Max combo is tracked.
- Multiplier: combo 0-9 = 1x, 10-19 = 2x, 20-29 = 3x, 30+ = 4x. Score gained = base_points * multiplier.
- Track counts: perfect, great, good, miss.

## Save/Load System
- A 'Save' button (id='saveBtn') serializes the full game state to JSON and stores it in localStorage key 'rhythmGameSave'. Saved state includes: score, combo, maxCombo, multiplier, perfect/great/good/miss counts, elapsed game time, note states (which notes are hit/missed/active), duck lane, and whether game is paused.
- A 'Load' button (id='loadBtn') restores the game state from localStorage. Notes that were already hit or missed should not reappear. The game resumes in paused state after loading.
- A 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') resets everything to initial state.

## HUD (DOM Overlay)
- Display at top: Score, Combo, Multiplier, and last hit judgment text.
- Display note counts: Perfect, Great, Good, Miss.
- Show elapsed time and total notes remaining.
- Save, Load, Reset buttons in a row below the HUD.
- All HUD elements should have clear ids: 'scoreDisplay', 'comboDisplay', 'multiplierDisplay', 'judgmentDisplay', 'perfectCount', 'greatCount', 'goodCount', 'missCount', 'timeDisplay', 'notesRemaining'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- gameStarted (bool): whether game has been started at least once
- paused (bool): current pause state
- score (number): current score
- combo (number): current combo
- maxCombo (number): highest combo reached
- multiplier (number): current multiplier (1-4)
- perfectCount (number)
- greatCount (number)
- goodCount (number)
- missCount (number)
- totalNotesHit (number): perfect + great + good
- totalNotes (number): 16
- elapsedTime (number): seconds since game start (paused time excluded)
- duckLane (number): 0-3 current lane of duck
- duckX (number): x position of duck
- notesActive (number): notes currently visible on track
- notesSpawned (number): how many notes have been spawned so far
- saveExists (bool): whether a save exists in localStorage
- lastJudgment (string): 'Perfect', 'Great', 'Good', 'Miss', or 'None'
- gameComplete (bool): all notes resolved
- notePositions (array): array of {lane, z, active} for all spawned notes
physics_constraints: Notes move at constant speed 10 units/sec along +Z. Hit detection uses distance thresholds from z=8. Combo multiplier follows strict bracket rules. Score must be deterministic given the same inputs. Save/load must preserve exact numerical state.
